## What happens

This paymaster pays a user operation's gas from its EntryPoint deposit when one stored key signs the sponsorship with ECDSA. Whoever forges that key can sponsor any operation at a zero token charge. A second paymaster with the same code trusts the same key. Both deposits are empty at the block.

## Evidence

- [_validatePaymasterUserOp](https://etherscan.io/address/0x7d3201fa7a85c0a5f9fa1c0c6b9d0b784368d2ac#code) accepts a sponsorship only when ECDSA recovers the stored signer.
- [updateSigner](https://etherscan.io/address/0x7d3201fa7a85c0a5f9fa1c0c6b9d0b784368d2ac#code) lets each paymaster's owner Safe (3-of-6 here, 2-of-4 at the copy) swap the key, not the scheme.
- The [copy](https://etherscan.io/address/0x2a19767ea4fde138f0836e4bcd9fde2a39fb5f75) runs the same code with the same signer; deposit and stake are 0 at both.

## Reviewer notes

### Mechanism

validatePaymasterUserOp (EntryPoint only) calls _validatePaymasterUserOp (Paymaster.sol 82-108): it parses validUntil, validAfter, token, amount and a 65-byte signature from paymasterAndData, and returns SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED unless ECDSA.recover of the eth-signed getHash equals the stored signer. On success the EntryPoint charges gas to the paymaster's deposit; _postOp (110-120) then pulls the signed amount of token from the operation's own sender to the treasury, so a forged sponsorship only costs the deposit, not other users' tokens. updateSigner (141-145) is onlyOwner and only swaps the address. At block 26438999: signer() = EOA 0x5437edbb73bcbbad2c7fe2cca23969e3b8e5baa4 (no code); owner() = Safe 0x8cef85a5... threshold 3; getDeposit() 0 and EntryPoint stake 0. Copy 0x2a19767e... holds the same runtime code (code hash 0x499bc9d4...), the same signer, owner Safe 0xec4a97ba... (2 of 4), deposit 0, stake 0, so one forged key exposes both.

### Checks

- Header facts: this address alone, at block 26,438,999.
- Ruled out: an ERC-1271 or second path: the only check is signer != ECDSA.recover (line 98).
- Ruled out: proxy or unused implementation: the tool reads no proxy slots and no DELEGATECALL; this address has its own signer and owner set.
- Ruled out: key unset: signer() returns a nonzero EOA with no code at the block.
- Ruled out: the old card's 751,773 transactions and the last-active date: not re-checkable through the gateway, left out.
- Ruled out: funds at stake today: deposit and stake are 0 at both paymasters, so nothing can be taken until one is refilled; value does not change the rating.
